subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the live proof plus close-handler mitigation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88841 sufficient to land a bounded Discord reconnect fix, or must the hidden shouldReconnect-clearing transition be identified first?
rationale: The issue now has fresh live proof and current source still shows the risky gate, but the open PR discussion contains a maintainer concern that static/public-path analysis has not identified the transition that creates the stale disabled-reconnect state.

options.title: Resolve The Existing Candidate
options.body: Review the updated proof and diagnostic story on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88841, then land it if the Discord owner accepts the chokepoint mitigation with tracing.

options.title: Require Root-Cause Transition First
options.body: Keep the issue and PR paused until a public lifecycle reproduction identifies the owner transition that clears reconnect before the active 1006 close.

options.title: Replace The Candidate
options.body: If maintainers reject the current mitigation shape, close or supersede the PR only after opening a narrow replacement tied to this live reproduction.

recommendation.title: Resolve The Existing Candidate
recommendation.body: Review the updated proof and diagnostic story on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88841, then land it if the Discord owner accepts the chokepoint mitigation with tracing.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc authored the current maintainer concern on the candidate PR and has recent related Discord gateway history.
